name: Multani Mitti 100g Face Pack
original_description:
The Fuller’s Mud is a gift of nature. Multani Mitti  Face Pack is a natural mud which can be used for skin care by applying on the face. It has to be created into paste either by mixing in plain water or with rose water. MultaniMati has natural cleansing properties which help to clean the skin. Regular use may help to make the skin soft and smooth.

Multani Mitti Herbal Face Pack an be used for all skin types:

  • For oily skin, it should be used with water
  • For normal skin, it should be used with both milk and water in equal proportions i.e. 1:1 Milk: Water
  • For Dry skin, it should be used with Milk
  • Besides MultaniMati can alse be used in combination with other herbal powders like Rose Petal powder, Orange Peel Powder, Sandalwood Powder to make your own face packs.

Ingredients of Multani Mitti Herbal Face Pack:

  • MultaniMati 100% (Fullers Earth)
  • Pure, Natural & Safe
  • “Perfume- free & Chemical- free”
  • Allergic advice: This is a natural product. A skin test would be recommended to avoid any reactions due to individual sensitivity. Apply a small amount of the paste behind the ear. Wash it off once it dries. Wait for 24 hours, if there is no redness or itching it is safe for use.
  • Note:  This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease
NATURAL CLEANSING MUD
  • Removes dead cells, dirt & opens up clogged pores
  • Reduces acne, blemishes, scars & pigmentation
  • Helps keep skin soft & smooth
rewritten_description:
Multani Mitti 100g Face Pack is a natural, earthy substance that can be used to create a paste for application on the face. To use, mix with plain water or rose water to create a paste. This face pack can be used by individuals with various skin types, including oily, normal, and dry skin. For oily skin, it is recommended to use with water, while normal skin can benefit from a combination of milk and water. Dry skin may benefit from using the face pack with milk. Additionally, Multani Mitti can be combined with other herbal powders, such as Rose Petal powder, Orange Peel Powder, and Sandalwood Powder, to create customized face packs.

The ingredients of Multani Mitti 100g Face Pack include 100% Multani Mitti, also known as Fullers Earth, which is pure, natural, and safe. This product is perfume-free and chemical-free. As with any new skincare product, it is recommended to perform a skin test to check for individual sensitivity. Apply a small amount of the paste behind the ear, wash it off once it dries, and wait 24 hours to check for any adverse reactions.

This face pack is made from natural ingredients and is free from harsh chemicals. It is designed to be used as part of a skincare routine.
